name: glitch-blocks
prompt: Digital glitch blocks that shift horizontally and change every few frames, over a simple gradient. Intensity slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader with glitch blocks that shift sideways and colour-split over a navy-to-pink gradient. They change `uRate` times per second (8 by default), and `uIntensity` (0–1) sets how strong the glitching is; at 0 you get the clean gradient. I didn't compile or render it because no Powermove tools were connected in this run. Other sliders are `uBlockSize` and `uRGBSplit`, plus colour pickers `uColorA` and `uColorB`.
